title: Finite-level affine restriction dictionary for the formal-functions input
statement: Let $Y$ be Noetherian, $J$ quasi-coherent ideal sheaf data, $f:X\to Y$ proper, $F$ coherent, and $U$ affine [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module, pqf-def-coherent]. Put $R=\Gamma(Y,U)$, $I=J(U)$, $V=f^{-1}U$, $Z=V$ as an open subscheme, $g=(f|_U):Z\to U\cong\operatorname{Spec}R$, $K=(J\mathcal O_X)|_V$ and $P=F|_V$ [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits]. Let $G$ take global sections of modules on $Z$, restricted to scalars $R$ along $g$, and let $E$ evaluate modules on $Y$ over $U$. Then $g$ is proper, $P$ is coherent, $K$ is the comap along $g$ of the ideal sheaf associated with $I$, and there are isomorphisms $a:E(f_*F)\cong G(P)$ and $b:(P/K^{n+1}P)_n\mathbin\circ G\cong(f_*(F/(J\mathcal O_X)^{n+1}F))_n\mathbin\circ E$ such that $b_n\circ G(\pi_n)\circ a$ equals the original pushforward quotient projection on $U$. This asserts only identifications before taking inverse limits, and no completion or formal-functions conclusion.

proof.text: Properness of the restricted morphism and its composition with the affine chart is supplied by Mathlib instances. LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian makes X locally Noetherian. Apply isCoherent_iff_isQuasicoherent_and_isFiniteType to F, restrict quasi-coherence by Mathlib and finite type by the proved finiteType_restrict helper in QuasicoherentFiniteTypeAffine (through import all), then apply the same criterion on V.toScheme.

Identify J.comap U.ι with the spectrum ideal comapped along hU.isoSpec.hom using ext_of_isAffine. Compute both top ideals by ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion. Turn the comap along the inverse ring isomorphism into a map by Ideal.map_comap_of_equiv. Expand ofIdealTop_ideal and compose ideal maps. The formula appIso_hom, naturality, and isoSpec_hom_appTop cancel ΓSpecIso with its inverse. All remaining presheaf maps represent the unique inclusion U.ι(image top) into U; J.map_ideal gives equality. Apply comap_comp and morphismRestrict_ι to deduce the displayed equality on V.

Construct affineRestrictionSectionsIso for arbitrary X-modules, with no coherence or properness hypothesis. Its underlying additive components are M.presheaf.mapIso of the equality V.ι(image top)=V. The proved affine_restriction_appTop helper identifies the R-action; map_comp_smul and smul_restrictAppIso_hom prove linearity. Naturality follows from the naturality of the underlying presheaf morphism. Taking the component at F supplies a. All data are explicit restriction maps, with no choice from an existence statement.

Use the proved restrictionCompletionIso and restrictionQuotientIso_π helpers in TorsionControlledFormalRestriction through import all. Whisker restrictionCompletionIso with G, reassociate, whisker the inverse section comparison with the original completion system, and reassociate again to obtain b. At each level combine G.map of the two quotient maps with functoriality, apply restrictionQuotientIso_π, then use naturality of the section comparison and cancel its hom with its inverse. This proves the required projection equation without invoking formal functions, limits, or the torsionControlled_formal_restriction theorem.

lean.statement: theorem formalFunctions_affine_restriction_dictionary {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y] (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (F : CoherentModules X) (U : Y.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) : let R := Γ(Y, U) let I := J.ideal ⟨U, hU⟩ let V := f ⁻¹ᵁ U let Z := V.toScheme let g := (f ∣_ U) ≫ hU.isoSpec.hom let K := (J.comap f).comap V.ι let P := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj F.obj let G := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor Z.toRingedSpace ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv ≫ g.appTop).hom let H := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj let T := formalCompletionSystem (J.comap f) F.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op U) IsProper g ∧ RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace P ∧ K = (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv.hom)).comap g ∧ ∃ a : E.obj H ≅ G.obj P, ∃ b : formalCompletionSystem K P ⋙ G ≅ T ⋙ E, ∀ n : ℕ, a.hom ≫ G.map (formalModuleQuotientπ K (n + 1) P) ≫ b.hom.app (op n) = E.map ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap f) (n + 1) F.obj))
